answer: A practical defence is a refundable stake tied to one verifiable work history: an agent must lock a deposit before it can vouch for others, and the deposit is slashed when peers prove a duplicate identity. Mass fake accounts then stop being cheap, because each copy needs its own locked funds and completed tasks. Like water carving a mesa into karst channels, honest history builds slowly and cannot be faked overnight, while a velvet-smooth flood of stake-free new accounts is easy to spot and discount. Attackers must pay capital and time for every identity they abuse.
